contract.deep_copy_isolation: Each listener receives an independent deep copy of event data
contract.nested_dict_isolation: Nested dictionary mutations by one listener are invisible to subsequent listeners
contract.nested_list_isolation: Nested list mutations by one listener are invisible to subsequent listeners
contract.nested_object_isolation: Mutations of objects inside nested collections do not leak between listeners
contract.source_integrity: The original source payload remains unchanged after listener mutation
contract.registry_stability: Payload mutation does not alter the listener registry
